answer: Blind seat labels: each grader sees answers under a fresh pseudonym per seat, so a clique cannot spot its own members. Pearl is the label table, sealed until reveal at close. Cedar is the 4 percent of seats holding two answers by one author, a leak probe. Thread is the matching test: a grader scoring both answers of a pair the same in 9 of 10 probes is flagged. Failure mode: authors leave style fingerprints that break the blinding. Check rule: flagged graders lose 25 percent of seat pay. Cheapest bypass: copy style tags unless labels rotate every seat.
